description:
REQUIRES: opi-fin.7.1 (UI behaviour + Stub), opi-fin.5.x (stateful migrations) merged.

FILES: All extensions that call ctx.ui fn-fields. Identified by grep for 'ctx.ui.' or 'ui.':
- status_line.ex (already stateful-migrated) + test
- custom_header.ex + test
- custom_footer.ex (already stateful-migrated) + test
- git_checkpoint.ex (already stateful-migrated) + test
- permission_gate.ex + test
- session_name.ex + test

FOR EACH EXTENSION:
1. Replace ctx.ui.set_status.(slot, text) with UI.set_status(ctx.ui, slot, text).
2. Replace ctx.ui.apply_fg.(color, text) with UI.apply_fg(ctx.ui, color, text).
3. Replace ctx.ui.notify.(msg) with UI.notify(ctx.ui, msg).
4. Replace ctx.ui.select.(opts, kw) with UI.select(ctx.ui, opts, kw).
5. Replace any other fn-field call patterns similarly.
6. Guards like 'if ctx.has_ui?' continue to work -- has_ui? stays on Context.

FOR EACH TEST:
Replace UIContext.new() + UIContext.bind(ui, %{set_status: fn, ...}) with:
  {:ok, ui} = UI.Stub.start_link()
  ctx = Context.new(%{cwd: '/tmp', has_ui?: true, ui: ui})
  handler.(event, ctx)
  assert UI.Stub.calls(ui) == [{:set_status, 'slot', 'text'}]

Migrate extensions one at a time. Each can be a separate commit.
title: Migrate UI-using extensions to UI behaviour
